text: China's August industrial profits rise 4.2% YoY. January-August electronics manufacturing profits rise 110%, while automobile manufacturing profits fall 16%. Aggregate January-August industrial profit growth stands at 15.7%.

meta.note: Sector-level profit dispersion coexists with positive aggregate industrial profit growth.

text: Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform places capability limits and monitoring around AI agents. OpenShell constrains agent access through CPUs, while Sentry monitors agent activity through network processors. Multiple infrastructure providers support the reference design.

meta.note: The platform spans execution and network layers rather than a single enforcement point.

text: Treasury appoints longtime Jefferies strategist David Zervos as counselor to Secretary Scott Bessent. Zervos enters as a special government employee after prior Federal Reserve service, placing private-market and prior public-sector experience within Treasury's advisory structure.

meta.note: Special government employee status bounds the appointment's duration and employment structure.
